actions.reason: C0001 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence (inflammatory/immune RNA activation with reciprocal metabolic down-regulation, PBRM1-depletion and ATM-absence at WXS, concordant CNV enrichment at VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/BAP1 plus chr14q and CDKN2A loss). Cross-modal diagnostics show broadly supported membership (median 3/4 modalities) with positive, if small, internal cohesion and a detectable boundary to C0002, and confounder assessment shows only a weak, non-significant-at-set-level site association with no warning flags. Known-label echo is negligible. No material unresolved question requires an available request, so this candidate is retained for downstream validation.

C0002 has coherent multi-modality identity evidence that is the reciprocal of C0001 (metabolic-pathway up-regulation with reduced inflammatory signaling, PBRM1/ATM enrichment at WXS, lower CNV burden at VHL/SETD2/PBRM1/BAP1 with depletion of chr14q, chr6p, and CDKN2A losses). Cross-modal diagnostics show broadly supported membership (median 3/4 modalities) with positive internal cohesion and a detectable boundary to C0001, and confounder assessment shows only a weak, non-significant-at-set-level site association with no warning flags. Known-label echo is negligible. No material unresolved question requires an available request, so this candidate is retained for downstream validation.
